name: University Domains List
tagline: Search universities worldwide by name or country and get domains and websites.
description: A free public API for looking up universities by name and country. Returns matching institutions with country, domains, web pages, and alpha-two country codes. Useful for email domain validation, school pickers, and education data enrichment.

auth.details: No authentication required; public unauthenticated HTTP GET endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: fully free and open; no published request quotas

use_cases: search universities by name for a school picker
look up university email domains for signup validation
enrich education records with official websites
